column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the South” renders “the Negev,” and “the lowland” renders “the Shephelah.”
Close to the Hebrew; “she urged him” follows the Hebrew; the Greek reads “he urged her.” “dismounted” renders an uncertain verb.
Close to the Hebrew; “the South” renders “the Negev.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the City of Palms” is Jericho.
Close to the Hebrew; “utterly destroyed” renders the verb for devoting to destruction (herem), and “Hormah” sounds like it.
Close to the Hebrew; the Greek reads “Judah did not take Gaza.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they could not drive out” fills in an elliptical Hebrew phrase, and “the lowland” renders “the plain (valley).”
